questions.q: In what forms can integral concrete waterproofing admixtures be supplied?
questions.ref: Building Technology Tables, p. 51 — Waterproofing of Concrete
questions.n: Integral waterproofing admixtures may be supplied as powders or liquids and mixed directly with concrete.
